questions.question: What does Moses repeat in chapter 5?
How did the people respond to hearing God's voice from the fire?
options: They built an idol of gold and bowed down to worship it
They fled in terror back to their tents in the camp
They rejoiced and sang songs of praise to the LORD
They were afraid and asked Moses to be the go-between
questions.answer: They were afraid and asked Moses to be the go-between
